label: D1 after a2 rare-to-S1 trial, or when policy strongly favours a2
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * (choice < -4) * ~((prev_action==2)&(prev_state==1)) ;; (phase != D1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (choice < 0)
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO/D2; the (phase != D1) term just corrects the shared intercept). Near-binary magnitude (~0 or ~3.5). Main driver: the previous trial was a2 reaching S1 via a rare transition: a2 S1 u gives the largest response (~+2.6 over the other D1 cells), a2 S1 r a smaller one (+0.3) that is large (+1.7 more) only when the D1 policy already leans to a2 (choice < 0). Outside a2-S1 histories it also fires when the D1 policy logit strongly favours a2 (choice < -4, +2.6). All other previous-trial patterns (a1 anything, a2 S2) sit below baseline. Previous-trial pattern alone: dev R^2 beyond timing 0.55; with the policy terms dev 0.74, test 0.72 (all ceiling 0.73). Observed-only history terms (last trial plus trial before, no policy) reach dev 0.61. No future variables used; choice is the policy output of the model itself.

issues: Large systematic gap the explanation never mentions: the feature switches off late in the episode, even when its trigger conditions hold. The timing baseline for D1 falls from 0.45-0.48 in deciles 0-5 to 0.008 in decile 9, and the timing baseline is additive, so it cannot turn off only the trigger cells. In the worst-fit windows from misses, trials t84-t99 have triggers present (a2 S1 history or choice < -4), the prediction is about 2.3-2.7, and the actual value is 0.

Adding one term, (phase==D1) * trigger_on * max(ep_trial-60, 0), raises test R^2 beyond timing from 0.72 to 0.83 (dev 0.85). Its weight is -0.074 per trial, so the response is fully gone by about trial 100. The improved fit is well above the claimed additive 'all' ceiling of 0.73, so the original fit is not close to the achievable level. A step at ep_trial >= 80 gives 0.82 test. Interacting only the a2 S1 u term with ep_trial >= 80 gives 0.78.

The explanation calls the magnitude roughly on/off, about 0 or 3.5, and treats it as set only by history and policy. In fact the 'on' level depends strongly on time in the episode. The claim 'phase and time are in the baseline already' does not cover this interaction.

The other claims hold. The feature fires only at D1 (GO and D2 are exactly 0). Residuals after the previous trial are a2 S1 u +2.25 and a2 S1 r +1.36, and every other previous-trial cell is negative (-0.2 to -0.36). The policy deciles for strong a2 (1 and 2) are about +2.3 to +2.5. The reported test score of 0.72 reproduces. A small leftover under-prediction after a1 S1 u (+0.11) is minor.
skeptic.revised_label: D1 after an a2 trial that reached S1 by a rare transition (strongest if unrewarded), or when the policy strongly favours a2; switches off over the last ~40 trials of the episode

final_label: D1 after an a2 trial that reached S1 by a rare transition (strongest if unrewarded), or when the policy strongly favours a2; switches off over the last ~40 trials of the episode
